text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain signs a memorandum of understanding with Abu Dhabi Development Fund, under which the United Arab Emirates grants 100 million dirhams ($27 million) to the island to build houses.
- The private sector is urged to take on 2,000 Bahrainis as part of a planned training scheme.
- Travellers to and from Bahrain face chaos as British Airways staff prepare to strike.
- Bahrain Petroleum Company to spend $3.5 million to develop Awali hospital.
- Around $1.3 billion is invested in investment funds managed by Bahrain Middle East Bank.
- Bahrain Middle East Bank to sign a $75 million loan with 24 banks on Sunday to finance its operations and investments.
